summary: The legal integer has at most 16 decimal digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted implementation performs one bounded decimal conversion, one zero filter, and one parse.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted source converts at most 16 digits to text, filters each character once, and parses at most 16 retained digits, establishing O(D) time over the complete legal width bound.

The dedicated regression compares the accepted adapter with an independent arithmetic oracle for the first 1,000,000 positive integers, deterministic full-range values, and every decimal-width boundary through 10^15.
